outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented schematic/model rendering derived from tomography (pre-conoidal rings, actin filament), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented schematic rendering of cellular structures (IMC, ER, actin bundles), not a data plot.
Panel C is a tomographic slice (micrograph) with filaments highlighted in green, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a 3D schematic/model rendering of the lateral cell section, not a plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged subtomogram volume (a micrograph-type image), not a bar/summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a tomographic slice (micrograph) showing a filament connected to a TPF, not a data plot.
